root_cause_analysis: Instagram Graph API returned OAuthException Code 4 (Application request limit reached) with Subcode 2207051 (Action is blocked). Meta rate limit or spam protection threshold has been triggered for publishing activity on this account.
actionable_instructions: Pause automated publishing to Instagram for 24 hours to allow the Meta API rate limit block to reset.
Log into Meta Business Suite or the Instagram app to check if an account check or security prompt requires manual verification.
Review API call frequency to reduce burst posting requests and comply with Meta Graph API rate limits.
